# Read the authenticated field of the OS-keystore result

Accepted QR authorization and password viewing both await ensureLoggedIn and inspect loggedIn.authenticated. A result object can exist while that field is false. Scoped syntax recommendation for these two consumers: test the explicit authorization result, not object truthiness, and await completion before generating or showing secret data. The OS dialog, platform service and paired Gecko implementation were not run. This is source and test inspection only. Full Bugzilla and historical review discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran.

Scope: mail/components/preferences.
